Where the Story Moves Forward

As players explore the world and develop their faction, they will encounter moments when something important happens.

A mysterious discovery.
A dangerous decision.
A problem that demands action.

These moments are called Campaign Beats.

Campaign Beats are the engine that drives the story of Bad Eden.

They present situations that require players to make meaningful choices, and those choices shape what happens next.

What a Beat Represents

A Campaign Beat represents a turning point in the narrative.

It may introduce:

• a new mystery
• a difficult moral choice
• a dangerous threat
• an unexpected opportunity

Each beat asks the players a simple question:

“What do you do?”

The answer determines how the world changes.

When Beats Occur

Campaign Beats can occur at many moments during play.

They often happen when players:

• enter a new hex
• investigate a location
• encounter a strange phenomenon
• confront an important NPC
• trigger a story event

Beats can appear during exploration, travel, or faction activity.

They help ensure that player actions always lead to meaningful consequences.

Choices and Consequences

Every beat presents one or more choices.

Players may need to decide whether to:

• negotiate or confront
• investigate further or move on
• help a community or protect their faction
• risk danger for a potential reward

Each choice leads to different outcomes.

Some choices create immediate results.
Others shape the campaign over time.

In Bad Eden, the world remembers what players decide.

Beats and the World

The outcomes of Campaign Beats often produce lasting changes.

These changes may include:

• new allies or enemies
• shifts in faction reputation
• discoveries about the world
• alterations to hex conditions
• new opportunities for exploration

Because of this, Campaign Beats help transform the campaign map from a static environment into a living world shaped by player decisions.

Beats and Raids

Sometimes a Campaign Beat leads directly to a major conflict.

If a powerful threat must be confronted, the beat may trigger a Raid.

In these cases, the narrative situation created by the beat determines:

• why the conflict occurs
• what the objectives are
• what consequences follow

This allows raids to feel like part of the story rather than isolated battles.

Beats and Exploration

Exploration is one of the most common ways to trigger Campaign Beats.

When players enter new regions of the map, they may discover:

• ancient ruins
• struggling communities
• strange magical phenomena
• hidden dangers

Each discovery may create a beat that asks the players how they wish to respond.

The Beat Cycle

Most Campaign Beats follow a simple narrative structure.

Situation Appears
      ↓
Players Investigate
      ↓
Choices Are Presented
      ↓
Players Decide
      ↓
Consequences Occur
      ↓
The World Changes

This cycle allows the campaign to evolve naturally through player action.

Small Beats and Major Beats

Not every beat carries the same weight.

Some beats represent small moments, such as meeting a traveler or discovering a clue.

Others represent major turning points that may affect entire regions of the world.

Both types are important.

Small beats create atmosphere and discovery.
Major beats reshape the direction of the campaign.

Beats and the Great Work

Campaign Beats are the moments where players decide how they will repair the world.

Through these decisions, players may:

• stabilize fragile communities
• confront sources of corruption
• recover lost knowledge
• strengthen their faction

Each beat becomes another step toward completing the Great Work.

What Players Should Remember

Three ideas define Campaign Beats.

1 — Beats create meaningful choices

They present situations where player decisions matter.

2 — Beats drive the story

They introduce problems, mysteries, and opportunities.

3 — Beats change the world

The consequences of each beat shape the future of the campaign.

In Simple Terms

Campaign Beats are the moments where the story asks the players what happens next.

Your choices determine how the world evolves.

Every decision becomes part of the campaign’s history.
